findings.item: Actual natural-job heartbeat finally is text_workflows.process_job, delegated through pa_spec_apps.process_job; Worker.process itself only routes. join(timeout=2) requests stop and waits boundedly; it is not proof of thread exit. Require later liveness/owned group evidence.

open_execution_gates: No concrete harness, stop shim, driver SQL boundary, network denylist or hard resource enforcement has been implemented/reviewed.
Six exchanges/eight method entries require independent counters installed before setup; deny before invoking handlers, retain provider/Worker transport None identity.
Exact worker/run/first Cold attempt/connection wrapper must cover original context enter, yield body and complete exit; success signal only after original final closure check, no W5 entry.
Original DomainError is retained with cause/traceback/diagnostic; any other BaseException, resource exhaustion, observer/cleanup failure is UNKNOWN/incomplete, not an original business rejection.
SQLite SQLAlchemy hooks alone do not close DBAPI direct execution; driver-level write closure must be reviewed without replacing semantic gates or changing G0 input identity.
RLIMIT_FSIZE limits individual file size, not aggregate directory. All files/temp paths, count, bounded writers, parent receipts and external output must be closed and accounted before start.
Parent monotonic deadlines must enforce prefix480/G0120/global600 with one owned group cleanup budget5+5; no retry or budget reset on cleanup reentry.
New explicit once-only execution authorization remains required; no prior full-PB/JS window is reusable.
scope: Retains exactly existing isolated environment/account source/software qualification substitutions; never production account qualification, real model permission or PB completion.
